UI_QuickRestart_NoData_Tooltip: No character data - start a new save with this mod enabled or use "Continue with new character" once to enable Quick Restart
UI_QuickRestart_SandboxConflict_Subtitle: The sandbox settings have changed since this world was created. Which settings should your Fresh World use?
UI_QuickRestart_SandboxConflict_Saved_To: Use sandbox settings from when the world was created. Recommended if you didn't change anything manually. A mod may have modified your current settings as part of its features.
UI_QuickRestart_SandboxConflict_Current_: Use sandbox settings as they are now. Choose this if you intentionally made changes and want them carried over.
UI_QuickRestart_Options_Tooltip: Randomizer options: choose what gets reapplied or randomized
UI_QuickRestart_Options_Gender_Tooltip:
Keep: reapply the saved gender.
Random: rolls a gender, with matching appearance, voice and first name.
UI_QuickRestart_Options_Profession_Toolt:
Keep: reapply the saved occupation.
Random: rolls an occupation; its granted traits are guaranteed.
UI_QuickRestart_Options_Traits_Tooltip:
Keep: reapply the saved traits.
Random: rolls traits within the world's point budget and mutual exclusions.
UI_QuickRestart_Options_Clothing_Tooltip:
Keep: reapply the saved clothing.
Random: picks an outfit from the game's outfit pool, the occupation outfit included.
UI_QuickRestart_Options_Spawn_Tooltip:
Keep: respawn in the saved region.
Random: rolls a region among those available for this game.
UI_QuickRestart_Options_Seed_Tooltip:
Keep: reuse the original world seed.
Random: generates a new seed. Fresh World only.
UI_QuickRestart_Options_Zombies_Tooltip:
Keep: reuse the saved zombie settings.
Random: randomizes the zombie settings within valid values. Fresh World only. This choice always wins over the Sandbox option for zombies.
UI_QuickRestart_Options_Sandbox_Tooltip:
Keep: reuse the saved sandbox settings.
Random: randomizes all sandbox settings except zombies, which follow the Zombies option. Fresh World only.
UI_QuickRestart_Options_Zombies_Warning:
This will fully randomize the zombie settings.
The result can be extreme, from harmless
to nightmare. At your own risk.

Continue?
UI_QuickRestart_Options_Sandbox_Warning:
This will fully randomize the sandbox settings.
It is really random: the world can turn out
extreme or barely playable. At your own risk.

Continue?
UI_QuickRestart_Options_SandboxMods_Tool:
Keep: reuse the saved sandbox settings from mods.
Random: randomizes the sandbox settings added by mods. Fresh World only.
UI_QuickRestart_Options_SandboxMods_Warn:
This will fully randomize the sandbox settings
added by mods. It is really random: the result
can turn out extreme or barely playable. At your own risk.

Continue?
